info.name: AppDynamics Alert and Respond Actions Snapshots API
List request snapshots for an application

params.name: applicationId
params.description: The numeric ID or name of the business application.

params.name: time-range-type
params.description: The type of time range for the snapshot query.

params.name: duration-in-mins
params.description: Duration in minutes for BEFORE_NOW and BEFORE_TIME time range types.

params.name: start-time
params.description: Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

params.name: end-time
params.description: End time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

params.name: guids
params.description: Comma-separated list of snapshot GUIDs to retrieve specific snapshots.

params.name: archived
params.description: When true, includes archived snapshots in the results.

params.name: deep-dive-policy
params.description: Filter snapshots by the deep-dive policy that triggered them.

params.name: application-component-ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of tier IDs to filter snapshots.

params.name: business-transaction-ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of business transaction IDs to filter snapshots.

params.name: first-in-chain
params.description: When true, only returns the first snapshot in a cross-application call chain.

params.name: need-props
params.description: When true, includes data collector properties in the response.

params.name: need-exit-calls
params.description: When true, includes exit call details in the response.

params.name: execution-time-in-millis-greater-than
params.description: Filter for snapshots with execution time greater than this value in milliseconds.

params.name: output
params.description: The output format for the response. Defaults to XML if not specified.

items.docs: Returns transaction request snapshots for the specified application and time range. Snapshots capture detailed information about individual request executions including call graphs, data collectors, and error details.
